- auto_researcher_webfetch_9f2a1c: source_url https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/ publisher PostgreSQL Global Development Group date 2025-02-20 note "users relying on pg_dump should update immediately"
pairs.answer:
## PostgreSQL 17.4 – Kurz-Überblick

Das Wartungs-Release **17.4** ist am 20.02.2025 erschienen und bringt drei Sicherheits-Fixes sowie über 70 Bug-Fixes.

- **CVE-2025-1094**: betrifft das Quoting in `psql` / `pg_dump`, Einstufung *hoch*.
- Laut der PostgreSQL Global Development Group sollten alle, die sich auf `pg_dump` verlassen, sofort aktualisieren.
- Der Update-Pfad ist unkritisch: Ein Minor-Upgrade braucht nur einen Neustart, kein `pg_upgrade` und kein Dump/Restore.

**Planungs-Hinweis:** PostgreSQL 13 erreicht am 13.11.2025 sein End-of-Life – wer noch darauf läuft, sollte den Umstieg parallel einplanen.

## PostgreSQL 17.4

The PostgreSQL Global Development Group shipped **17.4 on 2025-02-20**. It is a minor, cumulative bugfix release rather than a feature release, so the upgrade path is the usual one for the branch.

**What it contains**

| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Security | CVE-2025-1094 — a flaw in the quoting APIs allowing SQL injection via psql |

pairs.answer:
## EU Batteries Regulation — replaceable batteries

**Regulation (EU) 2023/1542** has been **in force since 17 August 2023**, but the provision most people are asking about does not bite yet.

**The removability rule**

Portable batteries in consumer appliances must be **removable and replaceable by the end user**, and that obligation **applies from 18 February 2027**. Until then the earlier product rules continue to govern.

**Points worth flagging**

- The rule covers **portable batteries in appliances**; light means of transport (LMT) and EV batteries are handled under separate provisions.
- **EV battery carbon-footprint declarations** start earlier, from **18 February 2025**.
- There is an exemption for **devices designed to operate mainly in water-immersed environments**.
- **Penalties are set by member states**, so enforcement severity will vary across the single market.

Text published in the Official Journal of the EU.

Grundlage ist die **Verordnung (EU) 2023/1542**. Sie schreibt USB-C als einheitlichen Ladeanschluss vor.

This crossing is run by Stena Line, which has held the concession on the western Baltic corridor for many years. The dense summer timetable takes effect at the start of May and runs through to the middle of September, with sailings roughly every ninety minutes during the day and a thinner overnight pattern.

Crossing time is a little under three hours, so plan for a leisurely lunch on board rather than a quick hop. Foot passengers must check in at least an hour before departure, and cars without a reservation are turned away entirely once the vehicle deck is allocated — there is no standby queue on this route, unlike the Puttgarden service further west.

## Visiting the museum on Munich's island

The Pinakothek der Moderne keeps a fairly generous winter schedule, opening late morning and staying open until early evening, with a long Thursday night that runs well past supper time. It is closed every Monday, as almost all of the Bavarian state collections are, so plan a weekday visit around that.

The historic mine tunnels are the highlight and remain fully open; guided tours through them are the best way to see the lower levels. Note that your ticket covers only the wing you enter, so if you want the aviation halls as well you will need a second admission on a separate day.

pairs.answer:
## The new packaging rules, briefly

The measure was adopted by the European Parliament in a spring plenary session in Strasbourg and takes effect the following summer, so member states have until then to transpose it. Because it arrives as a directive rather than a regulation, the substance can vary a little from one country to the next.

Enforcement sits with the federal environment agency, which can impose administrative fines directly; there is no transition window for schemes already in operation, and the obligation applies to every retailer regardless of size. Breaches are treated as criminal rather than merely administrative matters, which is the sharpest change from the old regime.
